svg.title: At sufficiently large periods its wrapped positions retain their actual locations and are separated by B2 j lattice units, while every position belongs to the same central block through level m + 1. The matching estimate therefore produces, along the original extraction order, degree-q labels whose products differ from the original cluster by a paid local insertion of amplitude A, and whose quota at level m is at most p. The quota comparison bounds their norm in the fixed finite-dimensional reference space by Kp. Finite-dimensional bounded compactness gives a nontrivial refining filter and a limit label Q. Both the paid mismatch and the quota bound persist on that filter. This is the precise survival statement used above: it retains the actual refinement filter, geometry, paid insertion, reference horizon and quota, in addition to convergence of the labels.
